items.description: AC unit living room, higher-output replacement
items.rationale: Affected item beyond repair, 9 m from hob so 2.3.10(c) does not apply; per 7.1.9/7.1.10 replacement is not new equipment but indemnity is limited to a like-for-like 3.5 kW unit. Case 38 like-for-like unit priced around 1350-1445.
Labour of putting the replacement in place is covered under 7.1.9(c), following the covered principal item; case 38 reference about 468-488.
Console chosen for appearance and not required is no replacement cost at all under 7.1.10 last paragraph, 3.5(d) and 7.1.8(a).
Ordinary carriage of a covered replacement is covered under 7.1.9(e)/7.1.12; case 38 reference about 40-43.
Surcharges for expedited or timed delivery are excluded under 7.1.12.
Administrative and processing charges are not a repair cost under 7.1.8(b).
